podcast.body: This album by Brian Eno had a strong impact on David Bowie. It was so influential that Bowie called Eno to join the recording sessions for *Low*, seeking his creative input. "El disco de Breyánino, a No der Grimble, había causado un forte impacto en él, por lo que lo llamó para unirse la grabación."
